verses.7:26: يَٰبَنِيٓ ءَادَمَ قَدۡ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكُمۡ لِبَاسࣰ ا يُوَٰرِي سَوۡءَٰتِكُمۡ وَرِيشࣰ اۖ وَلِبَاسُ ٱلتَّقۡوَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ خَيۡرࣱۚ ذَٰلِكَ مِنۡ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَذَّكَّرُونَ

meaning: The root "rysh" primarily means to feather an arrow, or to repair it by adding feathers. Tropically, it means to strengthen, aid, or enrich someone, like God providing for a person.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
